deferred.claim: Activate the first +1 loyalty ability: exile the top card, optionally cast it during resolution, and otherwise deal 2 damage to each opponent.
deferred.basis: +1: Exile the top card of your library. You may cast that card. If you don't, Chandra deals 2 damage to each opponent.

deferred.claim: Activate the second +1 loyalty ability to add {R}{R}; this is a loyalty ability, not a mana ability.
Activate the −3 loyalty ability to deal 4 damage to target creature.
deferred.basis: −3: Chandra deals 4 damage to target creature.

deferred.claim: Activate the −7 loyalty ability to create an emblem whose spell-cast trigger deals 5 damage to any target.
deferred.basis: −7: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast a spell, this emblem deals 5 damage to any target."
